problems.description: Attackers send deceptive emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) to reduce impact of stolen credentials
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain access to sensitive information or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify and block targeted phishing attempts
Educate high-risk users on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Enforce strict verification procedures for sensitive requests

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Monitor email accounts for unusual login activity and forwarding rules

problems.description: Misconfiguration of cloud storage services (e.g., S3 buckets, Azure Blobs) leading to unintended public exposure of sensitive data.
risk_reduction: Implement automated cloud configuration scanning and compliance checks
Enforce least privilege access policies and role-based access control (RBAC)
Enable logging and monitoring of cloud storage access

problems.description: Attackers compromise software dependencies or update mechanisms to inject malicious code into widely distributed software.
risk_reduction: Implement software bill of materials (SBOM) and dependency auditing
Use code signing and verify update integrity
Monitor threat intelligence for known compromised components

problems.description: Attackers manipulate training data or model parameters to degrade or control the behavior of machine learning models.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training datasets
Use robust training algorithms resistant to poisoning
Continuously monitor model outputs for anomalies

problems.description: Use of AI-generated synthetic media (audio/video) to impersonate trusted individuals and manipulate victims into divulging information or performing actions.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor verification for sensitive requests
Educate users on deepfake risks and detection techniques
Deploy AI-based detection tools for synthetic media

problems.description: Malware that operates in-memory or leverages legitimate system tools to evade traditional file-based detection.
risk_reduction: Deploy behavior-based endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions
Implement application whitelisting and privilege restrictions
Monitor for anomalous process and network activity
